---
name: Task Issue Template
about: This template will be used to standardize task definitions assuming compliance
  with the SMARTS framework.
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

# 📝 Title  
**[Short, Action-Oriented Task Name]**

---

# 🎯 Objective  
Clearly explain **what needs to be achieved** and **why it matters** to the project.  
State the expected outcome in a measurable way when possible.

---

# 📄 Description  
Provide a concise summary of the task.

Include:
- What needs to be created, modified, or reviewed  
- Key constraints (time limits, formatting, technical specs, etc.)  
- Dependencies or references (tag related issues if necessary)  

---

# 📂 Location  

Specify exactly where deliverables must go:

- **Folder Path:** `/folder/subfolder/...`
- **Branch Name:** `issue##-short-related-name`  
  _(Example: `issue23-update-api-docs`)_

---

# ✅ Acceptance Criteria  

Define clear, testable conditions that must be met for this issue to be considered complete.

- [ ] Specific measurable outcome achieved  
- [ ] Meets defined quality/technical standards  
- [ ] Follows repository structure and naming conventions  
- [ ] Ready for review  

---

# 📅 Timeframe  

- **Target Completion Date:** `YYYY-MM-DD`  

---

# 🚦 Urgency & Difficulty  

- **Urgency:** `1–5`  
- **Difficulty:** `1–5`
